shared_elements: low-relief carving on a tall upright rectangular slab/pillar
a horizontal band of repeated motifs across the upper part
small crouching animal/figure at the lower part of the field
justification: Both are tall upright fields carved in shallow relief with profile creatures and a horizontal band of repeated motifs across the top, and both place a small crouching animal-like form low in the field, which gives a loose formal echo. But the subject matter differs fundamentally: A is dominated by a single large anthropomorphic figure in profile with headdress, robe and held staff, while B shows only animals — a row of quadrupeds, a predator with foreleg, and a bird — stacked in registers with no human protagonist.
